transcript:
Patient Bot: Hi there. I need to reschedule an appointment I have this Friday.
PGAI Agent: Thanks for calling PivotPoint Orthopedics. Heard of Pretty Good AI. Am I speaking with Sarah?
Patient Bot: Uh, no. This is David Chen. I have an appointment on Friday, and I need to move it either Monday or Tuesday.
PGAI Agent: Thanks for letting me know, David. Are you calling to reschedule your own appointment, or are you helping someone else?
Patient Bot: It's for my own appointment. I just realized I can't make it on Friday. You check if there's anything available Monday?
PGAI Agent: Please provide your date of birth.
Patient Bot: Sure. It's January 8th 19 85.
PGAI Agent: I need your full date of birth, including the month, day, and year.
Patient Bot: Oh, right. Sorry about that. It's January 8th, d 5.
PGAI Agent: Go ahead and tell me your full date of birth.
Patient Bot: Sorry. I meant January 8th. 19 85.
PGAI Agent: Just to confirm, your name is David Chen, and your date of birth is January 8th 19 85? Is that correct? If so, could you please spell your 1st and last name for me?
Patient Bot: Yes. That's correct. David Chen. That's right. David Chen. That's d a v I d. And Chen is c h e n.
PGAI Agent: Would you like to use your phone number to look up your record? If so, please tell me the number you have on file with us. If you're not sure, just let me know.
Patient Bot: Yeah. Yeah. You can use my phone number. It's 5 5 5 1 2
PGAI Agent: Please tell me the phone number you have on file with us.
Patient Bot: Sorry. It's 5 5 5 1 2 3 4 5 6 7.
PGAI Agent: I have your phone number as 5 5 5 1 2 3 4 5 6 7. And your date of birth as January 8th 19 85. Is that correct?
Patient Bot: Yes. That's correct.
PGAI Agent: I can't proceed further right now, but I can make sure our clinic support team follows up with you. Please hold while I get this started. Connecting you to a representative please wait. Hello. You've reached the Pretty Good AI test line. Goodbye.
Patient Bot: Okay. Thanks for your help. I'll wait for the support team to get back to me. Alright. For your help. Have a good day. Goodbye.
summary: David Chen called to reschedule his Friday appointment to either Monday or Tuesday. After verifying his identity using his name, date of birth, and phone number, the AI agent was unable to complete the request directly. The call ended with the AI transferring David to a representative and assuring him that the clinic support team would follow up.
